text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Lovely sunshine, isn't it? Shall I brew 
some herbal tea that's perfect for a day 
like this?
choice_data_list: You seem to be in a good mood, huh.
You seem to be in a good mood, huh?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is it showing on my face? I simply 
thoroughly enjoyed spending quality time 
with my family.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Compared to when I was young, 
opportunities to spend time with my family 
are limited... That's why moments like 
this touch my heart all the more.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It was the best day off ever— it really 
made me appreciate what's truly important.
